mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medical_record (appointment_id, patient_id, doctor_id, department_id, chief_complaint, present_illness, past_history, temperature, pulse, respiration, blood_pressure, diagnosis_code, diagnosis_desc, treatment_opinion, referral_dept_id, referral_reason, status, is_return_visit, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{appointmentId}, #{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{departmentId}, #{chiefComplaint}, #{presentIllness}, #{pastHistory}, #{temperature}, #{pulse}, #{respiration}, #{bloodPressure}, #{diagnosisCode}, #{diagnosisDesc}, #{treatmentOpinion}, #{referralDeptId}, #{referralReason}, #{status}, #{isReturnVisit}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE medical_record SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_record WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
